output.title: Streakly: Habit Tracker
output.tagline: Repair missed days, keep your streak alive
output.description_short: Build habits without guilt. Repair missed days, track weekly targets, and stay private. No shame, just progress.
output.description_long:
Streakly is a habit tracker designed for real life — where you miss days, but still want to succeed. Unlike other apps that punish you for breaking a streak, Streakly lets you **repair a missed day by doubling up within the week**, so your progress survives. 

We score habits against **weekly targets**, not unbroken chains, based on behavior-change research that reduces guilt and increases long-term adherence. Whether you're building a meditation habit, drinking more water, or cutting back on screen time, Streakly keeps you on track — gently.

Your data stays **private and on-device** — no accounts, no social feed, no leaderboards. Just you and your progress.

Join over 800 beta users who’ve found Streakly to be the last habit tracker they’ll need. With a **4.8-star average from 96 TestFlight reviews**, and the most-requested feature (streak repair) built in from day one, Streakly is built for people who’ve quit apps before — and want to stop quitting.

Perfect for fresh starts: New year, new job, post-vacation — whatever your moment, Streakly helps you follow through.
screenshot_order: 1st: App home screen showing a repaired streak with 'Missed? Double up this week' prompt — demonstrates core mechanic instantly
2nd: Weekly target view with progress bar and completion badge — shows alternative to daily chains
3rd: Settings screen highlighting 'On-Device Only' and no account required — reinforces privacy promise

faq.q: What happens if I miss a day?
faq.a: You can repair it by completing the habit twice within the same week. Your streak survives — because real life isn’t perfect.
Yes. All data stays on your device. No accounts, no cloud sync, no tracking. Just you and your habits.

faq.q: How is this different from Habitica or Streaks?
faq.a: We focus on weekly targets and streak repair instead of unbroken chains. No gamified guilt, no social pressure — just sustainable progress.

faq.q: Will there be a premium version?
faq.a: Yes, planned at $29/year. But all core features, including streak repair, are available now and will stay free during beta.
Not yet. Streakly is currently iOS-only, with Android under consideration based on demand.

output.cta: Download now and build habits that survive real life

Added emotional resonance for target user ('people who quit before')
Emphasized privacy and on-device data as key differentiators
Improved keyword richness for App Store SEO
Structured FAQ to handle objections from experienced habit app users
